propositions: Four graph functions have elevated cyclomatic complexity (16-22) due to duplicated reduce-all-and-index loops and hand-rolled BFS patterns
The reduce_all → drop error/fsck → index loop is duplicated verbatim in _find_direct_blockers and _compute_dep_graph with identical policy
_get_all_blocked_by and check_cycle_at_level each re-implement an FS-walking BFS skeleton that drives complexity and duplication
Centralizing the shared reduction and BFS patterns into load_indexed_states and an accumulator-style bfs helper reduces duplication without changing node-sets or traversal semantics
All four target functions must fall to CCN ≤ 8 (or ≤ 12 for detect_newly_unblocked) and pass existing graph-subsystem test suites unchanged
The refactor is behavior-preserving: accumulator-BFS must exclude seed from result and include blocks targets even without backing ticket dirs, matching _get_all_blocked_by's current semantics
